description: Software Factory enforcement for the GitHub Copilot CLI and VS Code (Copilot and Local harnesses): agents propose, the CLI and these hooks decide. Native Copilot format (version 1, camelCase events); VS Code's Local harness maps it and sends Local payloads, so every script reads both payload shapes and writes both output shapes in one JSON object (flat Copilot fields plus hookSpecificOutput). No matchers — each script filters by the normalised tool name. Each entry has `bash` and `powershell` (the Copilot runtime uses these) and `command`, the same POSIX launcher as `bash` (the cross-platform field Local's own format uses; Copilot uses it only when bash/powershell are absent). Each command starts with H=<plugin>:<hook>, so a timeout warning names the hook. Every launcher ends in exit 0: if node is missing, too old or crashes, the hooks are off with a warning on stderr instead of denying every tool (a deny is JSON on stdout). The plugin root comes from the ${PLUGIN_ROOT} / ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} token VS Code substitutes (used only as a whole assignment value, since it is shell-quoted), the PLUGIN_ROOT / CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT / COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT environment variables, or ~/.factory/plugin-root (written by the factory CLI); a launcher that can't start its hook logs why in ~/.factory/hooks.log, which factory doctor reads.

sessionStart.bash: H=factory:session; R=${PLUGIN_ROOT}; [ -n "$R" ] || R=${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}; [ -n "$R" ] || R=$COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT; S=env; case "$R" in [A-Za-z]:*) command -v wslpath >/dev/null 2>&1 && R=$(wslpath -u "$R" 2>/dev/null);; esac; L=$FACTORY_USER_DIR; [ -n "$L" ] || L=$HOME/.factory; [ -f "$R/hooks/session-start.js" ] || { R=$(cat "$L/plugin-root" 2>/dev/null); S=file; }; lg() { { mkdir -p "$L"; v=; [ -n "$PLUGIN_ROOT" ] && v="$v PLUGIN_ROOT"; [ -n "$COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT" ] && v="$v COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT"; [ -n "$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT" ] && v="$v CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT"; printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\t{"launcher":true,"vars":"%s","root":"%s","platform":"%s"}\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$H" "$1" "$PWD" "$v" "$S" "$(uname -s 2>/dev/null)" >> "$L/hooks.log"; } 2>/dev/null; }; [ -f "$R/hooks/session-start.js" ] || { lg not_found; echo "[$H] hook script $R/hooks/session-start.js not found; hook skipped (factory doctor explains)" >&2; exit 0; }; command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1 || { lg node_missing; echo "[$H] node is not on PATH; factory hooks are off (the guard allows everything)" >&2; exit 0; }; node "$R/hooks/session-start.js" sessionStart || { c=$?; V=$(node -v 2>/dev/null); case "$V" in v[0-9].*|v1[0-3].*) lg "node_old $V"; echo "[$H] node $V is too old for the factory hooks (they need Node 14 or newer): factory hooks are off (the guard allows everything)" >&2;; *) lg "failed exit $c"; echo "[$H] hook failed (exit $c); allowed" >&2;; esac; }; exit 0
sessionStart.powershell: $h='factory:session'; $r=${PLUGIN_ROOT}; if (-not $r) { $r=${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} }; if (-not $r) { $r=$env:PLUGIN_ROOT }; if (-not $r) { $r=$env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT }; if (-not $r) { $r=$env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT }; $l=$env:FACTORY_USER_DIR; if (-not $l) { $l=Join-Path $HOME '.factory' }; if (-not (Test-Path "$r/hooks/session-start.js")) { $r=(Get-Content -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue (Join-Path $l 'plugin-root') | Select-Object -First 1) }; function lg($o) { try { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $l | Out-Null; $v=(@('PLUGIN_ROOT','COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT','CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT') | Where-Object { [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable($_) }) -join ' '; Add-Content -Path (Join-Path $l 'hooks.log') -Value ((Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString('yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ') + "`t$h`t$o`t$PWD`t" + '{"launcher":true,"vars":"' + $v + '","platform":"win32"}') } catch {} }; if (-not (Test-Path "$r/hooks/session-start.js")) { lg 'not_found'; [Console]::Error.WriteLine("[$h] hook script $r/hooks/session-start.js not found; hook skipped (factory doctor explains)"); exit 0 }; if (-not (Get-Command node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { lg 'node_missing'; [Console]::Error.WriteLine("[$h] node is not on PATH; factory hooks are off (the guard allows everything)"); exit 0 }; node "$r/hooks/session-start.js" sessionStart; $c=$LASTEXITCODE; if ($c -ne 0) { $v=(node -v 2>$null); if ("$v" -match '^v(\d+)\.' -and [int]$Matches[1] -lt 14) { lg "node_old $v"; [Console]::Error.WriteLine("[$h] node $v is too old for the factory hooks (they need Node 14 or newer): factory hooks are off (the guard allows everything)") } else { lg "failed exit $c"; [Console]::Error.WriteLine("[$h] hook failed (exit $c); allowed") } }; exit 0
